rows.name: putnam_1964_b1
rows.proof:
import Mathlib

open Set Function Filter Topology

/--
Let $a_n$ be a sequence of positive integers such that $\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} 1/a_n$ converges. For all $n$, let $b_n$ be the number of $a_n$ which are at most $n$. Prove that $\lim_{n \to \infty} b_n/n = 0$.
-/
theorem putnam_1964_b1
    (a b : ℕ → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n, 0 < a n)
    (h' : Summable fun n ↦ (1 : ℝ) / a n)
    (h'' : ∀ n, b n = {k | a k ≤ n}.ncard) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ (b n : ℝ) / n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hfin : ∀ n : ℕ, {k | a k ≤ n}.Finite := by
    intro n
    have h0 := h'.tendsto_cofinite_zero
    have hpos1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have hev : ∀ᶠ k in Filter.cofinite, (1 : ℝ) / a k < 1 / ((n:ℝ) + 1) :=
      h0.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hpos1)
    rw [Filter.eventually_cofinite] at hev
    refine hev.subset ?_
    intro k hk
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at hk ⊢
    intro hlt
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < a k := by exact_mod_cast h k
    have hle : (a k : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hk
    have : (1:ℝ) / ((n:ℝ)+1) < 1 / a k :=
      one_div_lt_one_div_of_lt hpos (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hε2pos : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → 0 < ε / 2 := fun ε hε => by positivity
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  have hε2 : (0:ℝ) < ε / 2 := hε2pos ε hε
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := summable_iff_vanishing_norm.mp h' (ε/2) hε2
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((s.card : ℝ) / (ε/2))
  refine ⟨M + 1, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  have hnpos : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < n)
  obtain ⟨T, hTmem, hTcard⟩ : ∃ T : Finset ℕ, (∀ k, k ∈ T ↔ a k ≤ n) ∧ b n = T.card := by
    refine ⟨(hfin n).toFinset, fun k => ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · rw [h'', Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ (hfin n)]
  obtain ⟨t, htmem⟩ : ∃ t : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, k ∈ t ↔ k ∈ T ∧ k ∉ s :=
    ⟨T.filter (fun k => k ∉ s), fun k => Finset.mem_filter⟩
  have hdisj : Disjoint t s :=
    Finset.disjoint_left.mpr (fun k hk hks => ((htmem k).1 hk).2 hks)
  have hsub : T ⊆ t ∪ s := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_union]
    by_cases hks : k ∈ s
    · right; exact hks
    · left; exact (htmem k).2 ⟨hk, hks⟩
  have hbnat : b n ≤ t.card + s.card := by
    rw [hTcard]
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (Finset.card_union_le t s)
  have hnorm : ‖∑ i ∈ t, (1:ℝ) / a i‖ < ε/2 := hs t hdisj
  have hlow : t.card • ((1:ℝ)/n) ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (1:ℝ)/a i := by
    refine Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum t (fun i => (1:ℝ)/a i) _ ?_
    intro k hk
    have hkT := ((htmem k).1 hk).1
    have hle : a k ≤ n := (hTmem k).1 hkT
    have hpos : (0:ℝ) < a k := by exact_mod_cast h k
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le hpos (by exact_mod_cast hle)
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul] at hlow
  have hself : (∑ i ∈ t, (1:ℝ) / a i) ≤ ‖∑ i ∈ t, (1:ℝ) / a i‖ := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact le_abs_self _
  have hct : (t.card:ℝ) * (1/n) < ε/2 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (hlow.trans hself) hnorm
  have htc : (t.card:ℝ) < ε/2 * n := by
    have := hct
    rw [mul_one_div, div_lt_iff₀ hnpos] at this
    exact this
  have hM2 := hM
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hε2] at hM2
  have hMn : (M:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : M ≤ n)
  have hMn2 : (M:ℝ) * (ε/2) ≤ n * (ε/2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hMn hε2.le
  have hb : (b n : ℝ) ≤ t.card + s.card := by exact_mod_cast hbnat
  have hnn : 0 ≤ (b n : ℝ) / n := by positivity
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hnn, div_lt_iff₀ hnpos]
  nlinarith

rows.name: putnam_1965_b3
rows.proof:
import Mathlib

open EuclideanGeometry Topology Filter Complex

/--
Prove that there are exactly three right triangles (up to orientation and translation) with integer side lengths and area equal to twice their perimeter.
-/
theorem putnam_1965_b3
: {(a, b, c) : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ | a > 0 ∧ a ≤ b ∧ c > 0 ∧ a^2 + b^2 = c^2 ∧ a*b/(2 : ℚ) = 2*(a + b + c)}.ncard = 3 :=
by
  have hset : {(a, b, c) : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ | a > 0 ∧ a ≤ b ∧ c > 0 ∧ a^2 + b^2 = c^2 ∧ a*b/(2 : ℚ) = 2*(a + b + c)}
      = ({(9, 40, 41), (10, 24, 26), (12, 16, 20)} : Set (ℤ × ℤ × ℤ)) := by
    ext ⟨a, b, c⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ha, hab, hc0, hc, hq⟩
      have h' : (a:ℚ) * b = 4 * (a + b + c) := by linarith
      have h : a * b = 4 * (a + b + c) := by exact_mod_cast h'
      have h4 : 4 * c = a * b - 4 * a - 4 * b := by linarith
      have h5 : (a * b - 4 * a - 4 * b) ^ 2 = 16 * (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        rw [← h4, hc]; ring
      have h6 : a * b * ((a - 8) * (b - 8) - 32) = 0 := by linear_combination h5
      have hb : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hab
      have hab0 : a * b ≠ 0 := (mul_pos ha hb).ne'
      have h7 : (a - 8) * (b - 8) = 32 := by
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h6 with h8 | h8
        · exact absurd h8 hab0
        · linarith
      have hle : a ≤ 16 := by
        by_contra hlt
        push_neg at hlt
        have h1 : 0 ≤ a - 17 := by linarith
        have h2 : 0 ≤ b - 17 := by linarith
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2]
      clear h6 h5 hc hq h' h
      interval_cases a <;> omega
    · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩) <;> norm_num
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_eq_three]
  exact ⟨(9, 40, 41), (10, 24, 26), (12, 16, 20), by simp, by simp, by simp, rfl⟩

rows.name: putnam_1966_a6
rows.proof:
import Mathlib

open Topology Filter

lemma putnam_1966_a6_step (m N x : ℝ) (hm : 0 ≤ m) (hN : 0 < N) (h0 : 0 ≤ x)
    (hup : x ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 3))
    (hlow : ((m + 1) * (m + 3) - x) * N ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 2) * (m + 3)) :
    0 ≤ m * Real.sqrt (1 + x) ∧ m * Real.sqrt (1 + x) ≤ m * (m + 2) ∧
      m * (m + 2) - m * Real.sqrt (1 + x) ≤ m * (m + 1) * (m + 2) / N := by
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + x) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + x) ^ 2 = 1 + x := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)
  generalize Real.sqrt (1 + x) = s at hs0 hsq ⊢
  have hs1 : 1 ≤ s := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs0 (le_of_lt (sub_pos.2 hc))]
  have hs2 : s ≤ m + 2 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.2 hc) (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < s + (m + 2))]
  refine ⟨mul_nonneg hm hs0, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs2 hm, ?_⟩
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hN]
  have ht : 0 ≤ m + 2 - s := by linarith
  have hd : (m + 2 - s) * (m + 2 + s) = (m + 1) * (m + 3) - x := by nlinarith [hsq]
  have h1 : (m + 2 - s) * (m + 3) ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 3) - x := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ht (sub_nonneg.2 hs1)]
  have h2 : ((m + 2 - s) * N) * (m + 3) ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 2) * (m + 3) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 hN.le
    nlinarith [this, hlow]
  have h3 : (m + 2 - s) * N ≤ (m + 1) * (m + 2) :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_right h2 (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < m + 3)
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 hm]

lemma putnam_1966_a6_key
    (a : ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ))
    (ha : ∀ n ≥ 1, a n n = n ∧ ∀ m ≥ 1, m < n → a n m = m * Real.sqrt (1 + a n (m + 1)))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m → m + k = n →
      0 ≤ a n m ∧ a n m ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m + 2) ∧
        (m : ℝ) * (m + 2) - a n m ≤ (m : ℝ) * (m + 1) * (m + 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro m hm hk
    have hm' : m = n := by omega
    have hann := (ha n hn).1
    rw [hm', hann]
    have hN' : (n : ℝ) + 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have e : (n : ℝ) * (n + 1) * (n + 2) / (n + 2) = n * (n + 1) := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self hN', mul_one]
    refine ⟨by positivity, by nlinarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ) ≤ n)], ?_⟩
    rw [e]
    apply le_of_eq
    ring
  | succ k ih =>
    intro m hm hk
    obtain ⟨h0, hup, hlow⟩ := ih (m + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    push_cast at hup hlow
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < (n : ℝ) + 2)] at hlow
    rw [(ha n hn).2 m hm (by omega)]
    exact putnam_1966_a6_step (m : ℝ) ((n : ℝ) + 2) (a n (m + 1)) (by positivity)
      (by positivity) h0 (by nlinarith [hup]) (by nlinarith [hlow])

/--
Prove that $$\sqrt {1 + 2 \sqrt {1 + 3 \sqrt {1 + 4 \sqrt {1 + 5 \sqrt {\dots}}}}} = 3.$$
-/
theorem putnam_1966_a6
(a : ℕ → (ℕ → ℝ))
(ha : ∀ n ≥ 1, a n n = n ∧ ∀ m ≥ 1, m < n → a n m = m * Real.sqrt (1 + a n (m + 1)))
: Tendsto (fun n => a n 1) atTop (𝓝 3) := by
  have hat : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) + 2) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_atTop_mono (fun n : ℕ => (by linarith : (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) + 2))
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hdiv : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (6 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (6 : ℝ))).div_atTop hat
  have hlow_t : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (3 : ℝ) - 6 / ((n : ℝ) + 2)) atTop (𝓝 3) := by
    have h := (tendsto_const_nhds (x := (3 : ℝ))).sub hdiv
    rw [sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' hlow_t tendsto_const_nhds ?_ ?_
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    show (3 : ℝ) - 6 / ((n : ℝ) + 2) ≤ a n 1
    obtain ⟨_, _, hlow⟩ := putnam_1966_a6_key a ha n hn (n - 1) 1 le_rfl (by omega)
    simp only [Nat.cast_one] at hlow
    have e : (6 : ℝ) / ((n : ℝ) + 2) = 1 * (1 + 1) * (1 + 2) / ((n : ℝ) + 2) := by ring
    linarith
  · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    show a n 1 ≤ (3 : ℝ)
    obtain ⟨_, hup, _⟩ := putnam_1966_a6_key a ha n hn (n - 1) 1 le_rfl (by omega)
    simp only [Nat.cast_one] at hup
    linarith

import Mathlib

open Nat Topology Filter

/--
Let $f(x)=a_1\sin x+a_2\sin 2x+\dots+a_n\sin nx$, where $a_1,a_2,\dots,a_n$ are real numbers and where $n$ is a positive integer. Given that $|f(x)| \leq |\sin x|$ for all real $x$, prove that $|a_1|+|2a_2|+\dots+|na_n| \leq 1$.
-/
theorem putnam_1967_a1
(n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0)
(a : Set.Icc 1 n → ℝ)
(f : ℝ → ℝ)
(hf : f = (fun x : ℝ => ∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, a i * Real.sin (i * x)))
(flesin : ∀ x : ℝ, abs (f x) ≤ abs (Real.sin x))
: abs (∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, i * a i) ≤ 1 :=
by
  have key : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → |Real.sin y| ≤ y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · rcases le_total y Real.pi with h | h
      · have := Real.sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi hy h
        linarith
      · have h1 := Real.neg_one_le_sin y
        have h2 := Real.pi_gt_three
        linarith
    · exact Real.sin_le hy
  have hsin : ∀ x : ℝ, |Real.sin x| ≤ |x| := by
    intro x
    rcases le_total 0 x with hx | hx
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hx]
      exact key x hx
    · have := key (-x) (by linarith)
      rw [Real.sin_neg, abs_neg] at this
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hx]
      exact this
  have h : ∀ i : Set.Icc 1 n,
      HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => a i * Real.sin (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * x))
        (a i * (Real.cos (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * 0) * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ))) 0 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * x) ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).const_mul ((i : ℕ) : ℝ)
    exact (h1.sin).const_mul (a i)
  have hd : HasDerivAt f (∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n,
      a i * (Real.cos (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * 0) * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ))) 0 := by
    rw [hf]
    have e : (fun x : ℝ => ∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, a i * Real.sin (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * x))
        = ∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, (fun x : ℝ => a i * Real.sin (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * x)) := by
      funext x
      simp [Finset.sum_apply]
    rw [e]
    exact HasDerivAt.sum (fun i _ => h i)
  have hsum : (∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n,
      a i * (Real.cos (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * 0) * ((i : ℕ) : ℝ)))
      = ∑ i : Set.Icc 1 n, ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) * a i :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by
      rw [mul_zero, Real.cos_zero, one_mul, mul_comm])
  rw [hsum] at hd
  have hf0 : f 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hf]; simp
  have T := hd.tendsto_slope_zero
  have hle : ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[≠] (0 : ℝ), |t⁻¹ • (f (0 + t) - f 0)| ≤ 1 := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with t ht
    have ht' : t ≠ 0 := ht
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, zero_add, hf0, sub_zero, abs_mul, abs_inv]
    rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ (abs_pos.2 ht')]
    have h1 := flesin t
    have h2 := hsin t
    linarith
  exact le_of_tendsto T.abs hle
